About the net

Good conversation travels.

The 2100 Net brings amateur radio operators together to share the everyday moments that make a community.

A social net with a simple idea.

The original 2100net.org welcomed hams to a friendly evening conversation on the Arizona Repeater Association’s Rimlink system. The name comes from its listed start time: 2100 hours, or 9 PM local Mountain Standard Time.

Net control gives the conversation a rhythm: first check-ins, then a second round for participants to talk about their day. New voices are part of the tradition.

More than a list of call signs.

The old site connected listeners through photographs, a chat room, streaming audio and pictures of gatherings. This new home preserves those memories while making the essentials easier to find.
